pages.text: $(bold)Master Marksman Rifle$()$(br2)The elite marksman variant of the FK15. Combines a spiral-rifled precision barrel with calibrated lock tolerances, reducing shot dispersion by $(a)65%$().$(br2)$(c)Requires powered Create Mechanical Crafters.$() This state-level firearm cannot be made on a crafting table.

$(bold)Mechanical Crafter Grid (3x3)$()$(br2)B B R$(br)M W S$(br)T I P$(br2)$(bold)Legend:$()$(br)B: Barrel Band$(br)R: $(6)Rifled Barrel (Spiral Cut)$()$(br)M: Flintlock Mechanism$(br)W: Rifle Stock$(br)S: Gun Screws$(br)T: Ramrod$(br)I: Tempered Gun Steel$(br)P: Precision Mechanism

$(bold)Precision Rifling Lathe$()$(br2)The Rifled Barrel is bored on a Create mechanical drill bench:$(br)$(bold)Pattern:$() Drill + Rifle Barrel + Precision Mechanism.$(br2)Assembled in Mechanical Crafters, it produces the prestigious gold-trimmed FK15-R Jaeger Musket.
